title: Director Quality and Mission Assurance
text:
The Director of Quality is responsible for leading the overall quality strategy, systems, and operations to ensure products meet the highest standards of compliance, performance, and customer satisfaction. This role oversees all Quality Control, Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, Documentation, Calibration, and In‑Process Inspection activities. The Director will lead a multi‑disciplinary quality organization and work cross‑functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Operations to embed quality throughout the product lifecycle.

**Organizational Structure** 
The organization is composed of over 25 employees. The Director of Quality will have three direct reports:

* **Supplier Quality Manager** – overseeing Receiving Inspection and Supplier Engineering
* **Manager of QA Support** – responsible for Documentation Control, Calibration Lab, Quality Analyst, Corrective Action Systems, In‑Process Inspection, and monitoring QA Training records. In addition, Customer/Government Property audit assistance and property movement tracking will occur under this group.
* **Quality Engineering Manager** – leading product quality engineering including Product data reviews and customer buy-off activities, Quality Auditing, First Article Report completions and reviews, and root‑cause analysis
